implementation.mechanism: Retrieve sources whose claim_id matches the query. Write all of them into intermediate notes. Copy every retrieved contradiction token into the final-report appendix. Score verdict on retrieved strength sums so stronger contradictions cannot be hidden by selection. An empty retrieval takes emit_impossibility_record, a distinct code path from emit_final_report.

negative_controls.description: Writes contradictions into notes, omits them from the final appendix, reports CONSENSUS on stronger contradictions, and treats a missing claim as CONSENSUS.
